title: Residency Playbook + Pinset Simulator and Attestable Evidence Export for Hosted API
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Build a guided decision playbook and an interactive pinset simulator in the Console that helps compliance and platform teams pick per-tenant/policy region pinning, preview routing outcomes, and produce an attested evidence bundle (signed manifest + logs) for audits. This ticket scopes the UX, API contract, evidence packaging, and minimal runtime checks required for a first production-ready release on Hosted API.
background: Customers ask for reproducible proofs that their traffic and data were handled within chosen regions for regulatory audits. Existing residency work focuses on declarative manifests and exports, but customers still struggle to reason about complex routing rules (fallbacks, burst capacity, multi-region fallthroughs) and to generate audit-friendly artifacts in one step.
goals: Create a Console flow (Residency Playbook) that walks an operator through decision points for region pinning (soft vs hard pin, route granularity, retention profiles)
Provide a Pinset Simulator UI that takes a tenant's config + sample traffic profile and visualizes per-request routing probability, likely fallback regions, and expected retention lifecycle
Expose API endpoints so infra and CI can run the simulator and produce evidence bundles programmatically
Produce an attested evidence export: signed manifest, compact routing traces, retention actions, and a cryptographic hash/metadata file suitable for compliance artifacts
non_goals: Support on-prem Private deployment attestation in v1 (out of scope)
Replace the existing residency manifest DSL — we'll consume it, not redesign it
Deep forensics-level request replay engine (only sample traces / summarized statistics in v1)
success_metrics: <25% time spent by customers in support for residency-related questions within 90 days of GA
>80% accuracy between simulator predictions and observed routing outcomes in a 7-day pilot for 3 customers
At least 3 customers download and submit evidence bundles during compliance reviews within 60 days of GA
acceptance_criteria: Console: Residency Playbook with decision scaffolding and inline help for soft vs hard pinning is available
Console: Pinset Simulator accepts tenant config and sample traffic profile, returns visualization of routing weight by region and top fallback regions
API: POST /v1/residency/simulate accepts JSON config and returns deterministic simulation result and summary metrics
Evidence Export: `Download evidence bundle` produces a ZIP containing manifest.json (signed by Redwood KMS key reference), routing_summary.json, retention_actions.csv, and a signature file
Evidence Export: Manifest includes fields: tenant_id, pinset_version, rules_snapshot_hash, simulator_seed, time_range
Telemetry: Simulator run includes telemetry events (simulator.run, simulator.result.summary) with latency <3s for typical payloads in dev region
Security: Evidence bundle generation requires operator role with residency:export permission and triggers audit log entry
Docs: PRD + developer API spec + Console mockups linked from ticket
proposed_solution: Implement a Console-first UX backed by a new simulation microservice. The simulator uses existing routing policy engine to deterministically expand rule graph for a seeded set of request attributes, compute per-region assignment probabilities and most-likely fallback paths. Evidence export will call the simulation engine and the auditing/logging service to assemble a signed ZIP. We'll add a lightweight API gateway route and Console pages that call the API.
ui_requirements: Residency Playbook: stepper UI with decision cards for 'Scope', 'Pin Mode', 'Fallbacks', 'Retention Profile'
Simulator: configuration panel + sample traffic generator + stacked-bar visualization for region assignment probabilities
Evidence Export: modal confirming operator identity and purpose, progress indicator, download link
api_contracts: POST /v1/residency/simulate - body: {tenant_id, pinset, sample_traffic, seed} - returns: {summary, per_rule_stats, top_fallbacks, simulator_seed, verifications}
POST /v1/residency/evidence - body: {tenant_id, pinset_version, time_range, include_logs} - returns: {bundle_id, download_url, signature_meta}
telemetry_and_monitoring: Emit simulator.run and simulator.result.* metrics (duration_ms, rule_count, simulated_requests)
Track evidence.export.started / evidence.export.completed / evidence.export.failed with operator_id and tenant_id
Console dashboard tile for 'Simulator usage' and 'Evidence exports' with counts and average latency
security_considerations: Evidence bundles contain summaries only; full request payloads must never be included unless customer explicitly requests (and is allowed).
Signed manifests will reference Redwood KMS key aliases; do not embed raw private keys in bundle.
Access control: only users with residency:export may generate bundles; generate actions must be audited
dependencies_and_blockers: ENG-72108: routing-policy-engine: expose deterministic evaluation API
ENG-73321: audit-log streaming and signed export infra
Legal review for signature language and artifact retention policy
KMS key provisioning and aliasing for evidence signing
notes: Prefer deterministic simulation using a seeded RNG so simulator results are reproducible and can be embedded in evidence manifests.
Simulator should be conservative: when in doubt show multi-region assignment rather than masking fallbacks.
We should reuse the existing residency manifest hash algorithm to populate rules_snapshot_hash in evidence manifest.
